description: This image displays a collection of 3D models of various lamps, arranged in a row against a dark grey background. On the far left is a standard white articulated desk lamp with a round base and a flared shade. Following it are several variations of articulated desk lamps primarily in blue with bright yellow accents on their springs and joints; one is dynamically posed in a whimsical, creature-like manner. A smaller, simpler blue desk lamp is also present. The final and largest object on the far right is a tall, blue tripod floor lamp featuring a large, spherical yellow shade and subtle red chain details connecting its legs. The models have a clean, stylized, and somewhat cartoonish aesthetic, ideal for animation or a playful environment.
